## How to Choose the Right Plate Rack for Your Kitchen
![Proper installation of plate racks in modern Indonesian kitchens](/images/blog/rekomendasi-rak-piring-terbaik-installation.webp)
Choosing the **right plate rack** requires careful consideration of several important factors. Based on our experience at [Sesoris](https://www.sesoris.com/shop), here's the complete guide:
The first step is to measure the **dimensions of the area** where the plate rack will be installed. Leave at least 10 cm of free space around the rack for air circulation and easy access.
• **Small kitchen (<4m²)**: Choose a compact rack with maximum width of 40 cm
• **Medium kitchen (4-8m²)**: A rack 40-60 cm wide is ideal
• **Large kitchen (>8m²)**: Can use a wide rack or combination of multiple racks
Consider the amount of tableware you'll be storing:

**Q: What's the ideal plate rack capacity for a family of 4?**
For a family of 4, the ideal capacity is 25-35 plates with additional space for bowls and glasses. Choose a two-tier rack system to maximize storage space.
**Q: Is stainless steel plate rack safe for health?**
Yes, food-grade 304 stainless steel is very safe and hygienic. This material doesn't react with food, is easy to clean, and resists bacteria.
**Q: How to prevent a plate rack from rusting quickly?**
Ensure the kitchen has good ventilation, dry the rack immediately after use, and choose quality materials. Avoid areas with high humidity for installation.
**Q: Can a plate rack be installed by myself without hiring a worker?**
Most modern plate racks are designed for easy installation with complete guides. However, for wall-mounted or built-in systems, professional installation is recommended.
**Q: How long does a quality plate rack last?**
Quality stainless steel racks can last 10+ years, aluminum 5-8 years, plastic 2-4 years, and wood 8-15 years with proper maintenance.
**Q: What's the difference between a hanging and countertop plate rack?**
Hanging racks save counter space and have better drainage, while countertop racks are more accessible and portable. Choose based on your kitchen layout and preference.
